view.scene_description: A blurry interior shot of a brightly lit convenience store aisle, flanked by shelves packed with colorful snack packages. A person in dark clothing walks away from the camera toward the back. Decorative hot air balloon lights hang from the ceiling. A blue promotional sign is visible near the center.

objects.label: person
objects.observation: A person wearing dark clothing, viewed from behind, walking down the aisle toward the back of the store. Their arms are slightly bent, and they appear to be moving forward. They are centrally located in the frame, partially obscuring background elements.

objects.label: shelves
objects.observation: Tall metal shelves on both sides of the aisle, densely stocked with various packaged snacks in bright colors like yellow, green, red, and pink. The left shelf is more in focus than the right. Items are arranged vertically and horizontally along the shelf edges.

objects.label: decorative lights
objects.observation: Two hot air balloon-shaped decorative lights hang from the ceiling, positioned above the aisle. One is white with yellow stripes, the other is red and white striped. They are suspended by thin wires and appear to be part of the store's decor.

objects.label: promotional sign
objects.observation: A blue rectangular sign with white and light blue text and graphics, located near the center of the frame at the end of the aisle. It has Chinese characters and a circular logo. It is mounted on a stand or wall, partially obscured by the walking person.

objects.label: ceiling lights
objects.observation: Long, rectangular fluorescent light fixtures mounted on the black ceiling, illuminating the aisle. They are positioned above the shelves and the person, providing even lighting across the scene.

<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.
